title: P1138 - P1138
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Sensör okuma hatası veya tesisat temassızlığı
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  MAF Emiş Hava Akış Sensörü (MAF) Sensör Okuma Değerleri
Kontrol edin:  Intake/Exhaust System for Leaks
Kontrol edin:  Secondary Air Injection for Leaks
Kontrol edin:  Vacuum Lines for Leaks
technicalNotes:
Fuel Trim Info
When this fault is stored and external vacuum leaks are not found, less obvious problems may be present:
Kontrol edin:  Evaporative Emission (EVAP) Canister Purge Regulator Valve (N80)
Kontrol edin:  Brake Booster and Hoses
Kontrol edin:  Electric Vacuum Pump ( If Applicable )
Kontrol edin:  Crankcase Ventilation System for faulty components. When the PCV or Crankcase Ventilation System is faulty, vacuum is typically present under the oil cap and misfire faults are common.
